description: Search and analyze email in Outlook OST/PST files directly on disk (pure Python [MS-PST] reader with a full-text sidecar index; no Outlook, no native dependencies; bounded memory, 10 GB+ stores are fine).
instructions: Read, search and analyze email inside Outlook OST/PST data files directly (no Outlook needed; any OS; the file is never modified). The model invokes it with {"action":"ostparse","command":"SUBCOMMAND [args]"}; the operator types /ostparse SUBCOMMAND [args]. Workflow: first 'open /absolute/path/mailbox.ost' selects the store for this session (no password is needed or accepted — ostparse reads OST/PST content directly; do not warn the user about passwords); then 'search QUERY' answers in milliseconds from a sidecar full-text index (FILE.ostidx) that is built automatically on first search and updated incrementally when the file changes — on a multi-GB store run 'index' once first, it is the only slow step. Subcommands: open FILE (reads any OST/PST directly) | close | info (header/format JSON) | tree (folder hierarchy with message counts and nids) | index [rebuild] | search QUERY [--limit N --offset N --sort date|oldest|size|relevance|subject|from --facet folder|from|domain|year|month|ext|class|size --exact --json --no-snippets] | count QUERY (exact match count) | show NID [--full] [--headers] (one message: addresses, attachments, body; NID is the nid=0x... token printed by search/tree) | export DIR QUERY [--limit N] (write matching messages as RFC 5322 .eml files) | stats (walk the whole store: folder/message/attachment totals; slow on huge files) | help query (full query syntax). QUERY uses Outlook Instant Search (AQS) syntax plus regex: words are ANDed; "quoted phrase"; OR, NOT, -term, (grouping); fields from: to: cc: bcc: participants: subject: body: attachment:report.pdf ext:pdf in:inbox folder:"sent items"; from:(alice OR bob); wildcards budg* b?dget; /regex/ with flags i c s m x; dates received:/sent:/date: (received:last week, sent:2024-03-15, date:2024-01-01..2024-03-31, received:march 2024, date:>=2026); sizes messagesize:>5MB size:tiny..enormous; flags hasattachment:yes is:unread is:flagged read:no importance:high; kind:email|meetings|contacts; messageclass:ipm.note; nid:0x200024 for one message. Typical investigation: open the file, 'search from:alice hasattachment:yes received:last month \"budget review\"', then 'show 0x200024 --full' to read a hit, 'count QUERY' / '--facet folder' to profile, and 'export ./out QUERY' to hand .eml files to other tools. Results are plain text, one numbered line per hit ending in nid=0x...; page with --offset. Example action: {"action":"ostparse","command":"search in:inbox from:david /inv-\\d{4}/ --limit 10"}. Command output is never clipped. Search --json returns a complete JSON document for the requested page; use --limit and --offset to retrieve additional pages. Search snippets are previews, not complete message bodies. Show returns the full available text body; --full remains accepted for compatibility.
